prose: Comfy Router is live on the Comfy Developer Platform: one API for frontier image, video, 3D and audio models, with the freedom to choose the provider for each job for better availability and better prices. Day-one access includes Seedance 2.5, MiniMax H3, Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Kling and Black Forest Labs, with more coming - the same models 3M+ ComfyUI users already use, now behind one API.
API keys and run history live in one account covering both the models called and the workflows deployed. Coming soon: deploying and scaling custom ComfyUI workflows with the Comfy API.
